reviews.title: Great AIO !
reviews.comment: Quiet quiet quiet! Keeps the CPU as cool as the other side of the pillow even under stress whist heavy CPU driven games! Looks great and is compatible with pretty much any build and is well worth the money.
reviews.author: Brett Becker

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: Runs great. I customized the screen with a pic of my gf, prettiest component of my build. it came with thermal paste already applied, just be careful it, I didn’t realize and I stained my desk lol
reviews.author: Ivan

reviews.title: This Aio is worth it
reviews.comment: Aio is amazing and the icue app is really easy to use the cooling is also great it keeps my 9800x3d below 50 with competitive games and 70 with high load games. Only thing to keep in mind is people said the fans were loud but i changed mine so in not too sure
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.title: great AIO, not exactly what i wanted
reviews.comment: looked great, screen worked, and was in perfect condition, it was quite on high speeds and kept my cpu nice and cool... no photos cuz i decided to switch to an MSI CORELIQUID instead because the fans threw off the entire build and it was cheaper than buying corsair fans
reviews.author: Logan McConnell

reviews.title: Definitely helps with temps
reviews.comment: Went to this to replace my 240 cooler for my ryzen 9 7900x helps keep it cool was getting to 95c on the old cooler only hit 70 when under heavy load on the 360 decently does its job well and the added screen is really nice to see temps no more pulling up extra software
reviews.author: Chris
